title: New Zealand shares experience of Vibrio outbreaks
summary:
This is Part 2 of a 3-part series

Researchers have detailed four Vibrio outbreaks in New Zealand that affected 117 people with 43 hospitalizations.

In many places, including New Zealand, Vibrio parahaemolyticus acute gastroenteritis is a legally notifiable disease prompting public health action.
